about.seoTitle: About Sivan Management — Property Management Company in Chania, Crete
about.seoDescription: Sivan Management is a Chania-based property and hospitality management company serving residential, commercial and tourism property owners in Crete.
about.title: Dedicated to your property. Committed to your peace of mind.
about.lead: Sivan Management is a Greece-focused property and hospitality management company, based in Chania, serving residential, commercial and tourism property owners.
body: Our approach is built around one principle: professional property ownership requires reliable local management, transparent communication and consistent attention to detail.

Owning property abroad brings real opportunities, and real responsibilities. An investment property needs regular oversight, reliable suppliers, ongoing maintenance, effective rental operations and informed decisions. Our purpose is to simplify that complexity for owners.
about.approachTitle: A complete approach to property management
about.approachBody: We bring property operations, rental management, hospitality coordination, maintenance and owner services together in one structured framework. Rather than solving each issue in isolation, we look at the whole lifecycle of the property: its condition, its operational needs, its commercial potential and the experience of the people who use it.
about.rootedTitle: Rooted in Crete. Connected to international owners.
about.rootedBody: We focus on Chania, Rethymno and Heraklion, where local market knowledge and dependable coordination make the difference. We serve Greek and international owners, investors and real-estate professionals who value accountability and proactive communication.
about.techTitle: Built on our own management platform
about.techBody: We run our operations on a property-management system we developed for our own needs, connecting bookings, maintenance, expenses, documents and owner reporting. Owners see the same information we work with, through the online owner portal.

values.title: Responsibility
values.body: We treat every property with the attention and care it deserves.

values.title: Transparency
values.body: Owners should always understand how their property is managed and what it costs.

values.title: Consistency
values.body: Good management depends on reliable processes and regular follow-through.

values.title: Local expertise
values.body: Practical knowledge of the market, suppliers and operating environment.

values.title: Long-term thinking
values.body: We look beyond this season to the condition and value of the asset.

about.commitmentBody: We aim to be more than a service provider: a long-term local partner for owners who want their property cared for, professionally operated and consistently supervised.
about.signature: Sivan Management — Your Property. Our Responsibility.

team.seoDescription: Meet the founder and the operating structure behind Sivan Management: property management, hospitality, maintenance, owner relations and reporting.
team.title: People who take responsibility.

team.founderBio: Sivan Menahem founded Sivan Management to give property owners in Crete what every owner wants: one accountable local partner, clear communication and full visibility of how the property is run.
